title: music-video brief
description: Everything creative about one video, as data. run_brief.py turns it into a rendered cut. inputs/clamor_hold_the_line.brief.json is a filled example.

name.description: run name: output folder and file stem

tags.description: genre -> instruments -> mood -> vocal character; no artist or song names

lyrics.description: original lyrics with [verse]/[chorus] section tags; one sung line per line

style.description: appended to every still prompt so the shots share a look

lines.description: how many lyric lines this shot covers; the sum over shots must equal the lyric line count

prompt.description: still/kenburns: the image prompt (style is appended)

motion.description: video: the Wan motion prompt (what changes, gentle verbs)

source_shot.description: video: index of the still shot whose chosen still starts the clip; must not be adjacent to this shot
